def transform(grid):
    """Tile a square grid with its 90°, 270°, and 180° rotations."""
    n = len(grid)
    if any(len(row) != n for row in grid):
        raise ValueError('expected a square grid')
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    half = [list(row) + clockwise[r] for r, row in enumerate(grid)]
    lower = [counterclockwise[r] + list(grid[::-1][r][::-1]) for r in range(n)]
    return half + lower
